tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, cards and forms on the steel ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, 2px rules, navigation bar, earned facts and done stations. 14.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill of Dark buttons; person avatar on the ink bar. White text 11.1:1.

tokens.name: ink-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of Dark buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table headers. 7.9:1 on surface, 7.0:1 on steel.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, not-yet facts, not-started stations and disabled options, on surface only (4.8:1 on surface; 4.2:1 on steel, so never on steel).

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: 1px row dividers and not-started station segments. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Hover ground of fields, rows and choice cards; read-only fields; disclosure body. ink 14.7:1, ink-muted 7.4:1.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill and disabled control borders; not-yet agent steps. ink-muted text on it 4.9:1.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: PSL orange: the current station where a person must act, Start work, the nav underline, decision headers, and error borders on fields (5.0:1 on surface). White text on it is 5.1:1.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill of Start buttons. White text 6.6:1.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Background of state tags and fact boxes that need a person.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text on signal-tint, Reject buttons and error text, and the pressed fill of Start buttons. 7.2:1 on signal-tint, 7.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons (Approve, Ask), links, agent panels' border. White text on it is 6.0:1.

tokens.name: action-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill of Primary buttons. White text 8.2:1. Pressed uses action-ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid, 2px gap, on every focusable control on light grounds. 5.3:1 on steel, 6.0:1 on surface, 4.9:1 on signal-tint.

tokens.name: action-tint
tokens.usage: Agent work panels, agent and processing tags, draft cards' header.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Text on action-tint, link hover, and the pressed fill of Primary buttons. White text 10.5:1.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Verified state and on-track notes. 5.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: verified-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill of Confirm buttons. White text 7.7:1. Pressed uses verified-ink.

tokens.name: verified-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Verified tags and confirmation bars.

tokens.name: verified-ink
tokens.usage: Text on verified-tint.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting state words and sample-data labels. 5.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: waiting-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Waiting tags.

tokens.name: waiting-ink
tokens.usage: Text on waiting-tint.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Background of neutral tags: closed, not applicable and information (Cancelled, Out of scope, Not yet, people and role labels, priority). Also count badges.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-tint. 7.5:1.

tokens.name: on-strong
tokens.usage: Text on ink, signal and action fills.

tokens.name: on-strong-tint
tokens.usage: Count badge ground on a selected (ink) tab or option.

tokens.name: focus-on-strong
tokens.usage: The focus ring on ink, signal and action fills (top bar, selected tabs). 15.7:1 on ink.

tokens.name: nav-muted
tokens.usage: Unselected destinations and the signed-in name on the ink top bar. 9.8:1 on ink.

tokens.name: toast-tick
tokens.usage: The tick in a success toast on ink. 8.8:1 on ink. Never text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind drawers, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: mascot-tola
tokens.usage: Tola, the PMO agent: identity only (chip dot, avatar ring). Never a state colour, never text.

tokens.name: mascot-tola-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind Tola's avatar and her chip.

tokens.name: mascot-chidi
tokens.usage: Chidi, the Finance agent: identity only. Never a state colour, never text.

tokens.name: mascot-chidi-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind Chidi's avatar and his chip.

tokens.name: mascot-zainab
tokens.usage: Zainab, the HR agent: identity only. Never a state colour, never text.

tokens.name: mascot-zainab-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind Zainab's avatar and her chip.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page titles on desktop, at font-stretch 112%. 26px on phones.

styles.name: drawer-title
styles.usage: Drawer, dialog and empty-state titles, at font-stretch 112%.

styles.name: panel-head
styles.usage: Panel headers and section labels, uppercase, 0.02em tracking.

styles.name: fact
styles.usage: The value in a facts-strip box.

styles.name: body-phone
styles.usage: Reading text and inputs on phones.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Field hints and errors, what-it-does-not-do lines, secondary lines in cards.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: State tags and the WORKING/DONE labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Breadcrumbs and eyebrows above titles, uppercase, 0.04em tracking.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between station segments and chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control; label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop (16px on phones).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every touch target and primary button.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, station blocks, inputs: the line is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and tags, to soften pixel edges only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: People avatars and radio buttons only.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Panel borders and section rules, in ink. The structure of every screen.

tokens.name: rule-thin
tokens.usage: Row dividers, in rule-soft.

size.note: Control heights. Every touch target is at least 44px; 40px only in the top bar, dense toolbars and segmented options on desktop.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Start work in the top bar, toolbar buttons, segmented options, menu items, select options.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, tabs and icon buttons on desktop.

tokens.name: control-phone
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects on phones.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Drawer footers, decision footers, Return and Reject on the phone action bar.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: The full-width main action in a phone footer.

shadow.note: Only floating surfaces cast a shadow. Panels on the page never do: the 2px ink border is the structure.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists, filter panels, date pickers and dialogs: a hard offset in ink, square like the line.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Toasts only, so they lift off whatever is under them.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Below this: phone top bar, stacked rows, bottom sheets, full-width actions, 16px gutters.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From this: side panels beside the main column; page content max 1320px.
